snippet.title: Fridge Frenzy (1985) - ZX Spectrum
snippet.description:
Oh dear! Whoever loaded Freddie's spaceship has caused quite a mess - they've packed everything into the refrigerated storage to save time. Now Freddie is trying to get home, but the radioactive fuel for the return trip (neutronium energy crystals) has dispersed in his fridge, so it's useless. Can you help Freddie collect the fuel he needs to get his spaceship off the launch pad? The radioactive fuel has had a rather strange effect on the contents of the fridge, which is now a dangerous place to venture into. It's also very cold, and Freddie will have to act quickly if he wants to get through all the shelves before he freezes!
